evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `Hold.acquire` creates the admission marker and fsyncs only the token file descriptor; it never fsyncs `self.path.parent` after creation. A file fsync does not make the new directory entry durable, so a power loss can lose the marker after the deploy has begun, defeating the admission guard. The same directory-sync gap applies to the release unlink. This is an implementation error in the existing crash-safe admission behavior, not a new requirement.
